text:
If you’re heading to the waterfront for sunset, plan on a cool, breezy view rather than a clear one. The sky may stay partly open through sunset at 6:52, but clouds fill in tonight, with north winds around 10 to 15 knots on the lake and waves near 1 to 2 feet. Temperatures slide toward 43, so bring a layer, and don’t linger on the water after dark.

Tomorrow is the nicer day: sunny, with a high right around 64 and a lighter north wind in town. The lake should settle some, though broad-water winds could still run 5 to 15 knots with 1 to 2 foot waves. The forecasters see a quiet, mostly dry stretch ahead, but cool nights continue, with patchy frost possible through Wednesday night. Sunset plans are fine tonight if you dress for it, but tomorrow is the better bet for a longer waterfront walk or paddle.
